Method of Attack: Disk-wiping malware that deletes files and overwrites Master Boot Record (MBR) and file data with 0x00 bytes
Includes ransom note to masquerade as ransomware
Kills critical OS processes causing BSOD or forced reboot
Loaded into memory, deletes its files from disk, renames itself
Targets storage devices to wipe data except critical OS folders
Impacted Systems: Windows systems in financial sector networks in Latin America
Previously targeted Ukrainian banks and power grid systems
Attack Vector: Dropped by another process/attacker, tightly coupled with installer or part of bigger malware package
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note left on infected systems
Kills processes: csrss.exe, wininit.exe, winlogon.exe, lsass.exe
